title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E06 — There's the Good, the Bad and Then There's Alaska
Alaska is home to many people who live by their own rules, which means law enforcement must deal with quirky characters of all kinds on a daily basis; some are good, some are bad and some are downright hilarious.

title: Alaska PD

A look at the next batch of top five outrageous outbursts featured on "Court Cam."

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E02 — Episode 2
A spit guard and shackles can't contain the rage of a convicted felon told he's going to jail for life; devastated family members seek justice in court-by any means necessary.

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E24 — Episode 24
An exchange of bullets at a suburban home ends with a dramatic courtroom exchange; a surprise performance by a man accused of attempted murder fails to impress the judge; hunger strikes, outrageous claims and shocking behavior in court from a killer.

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E28 — Episode 28
A reckless driver ends up in court after a shocking car chase caught on camera; an obscene screen name gets a defendant in hot water; a Hollywood actress ends up in jail.

title: Court Cam
description:
S05 E23 — Episode 23
A customer attacks fast food workers over her slushy order; a judge has no mercy for a corrupt sheriff; a suspended driver shows up for virtual court in the driver's seat of his car; and more.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E08 — Episode 8
A man attacks his neighbor, then faces jail time; a defendant ordered to turn himself in makes a run for it; a man has an outburst over his bond amount.
